initial_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent animated wind sprite atlas for a painted pixel-art 2D platformer. Primary request: large readable but delicate wind streaks, to show a gentle breeze across a volcanic Filipino landscape. Create a NEW 1536x1024 RGBA sprite atlas with an EXACT grid of THREE COLUMNS by FOUR ROWS, each cell exactly 512x256. Every column is one consistent wind-gust design; every row is the next animation frame of those same three designs, progressing downward. Column 1: one long flowing S-shaped ribbon of air with one shorter parallel wisp. Column 2: a graceful elongated curling breeze, a small open spiral at its left-facing leading tip, long tapered tail flowing to the right. Column 3: a pair of long gently arcing wind streaks with one detached short dash. All gusts travel from RIGHT TO LEFT. Frame progression for rows 1-4: unfurl, open fully, drift and flex, trail away; keep each design registered on the same centre and direction, with similar occupied length in each frame. Gusts should occupy about 400 pixels wide and 60-100 pixels high inside EACH 512x256 cell, with generous clear transparent margins. Entire sprites confined to individual cells, no overlapping or connecting cells. Style: elegant hand-painted PIXEL ART with visible crisp stepped pixel clusters, soft ivory / pale warm silver stroke colour, thickest main stroke about 6-10 source pixels, tips tapered to a point; NO bold outline. Draw only clean wind ribbon marks, with genuine transparent holes and genuine transparency everywhere outside the streaks. Strong enough body opacity for runtime alpha modulation; no painted shadow or opaque glow surrounding each sprite. No sky, landscape, characters, tree leaves, clouds, smoke, fog, paper background, checkerboard, typography, labels, grid lines, borders, or watermark. Treat this as a production animation atlas, not an illustration of a sprite sheet.

Treat this as a 384x256 logical pixel canvas enlarged EXACTLY 4x by nearest neighbour: every visible pixel cluster should sit on that coarse grid, all curves built from 4x4 square source pixels.
